issues.title: Implement JUCO Mode Toggle
issues.description: JUCO coaches need dual functionality (recruiting mode vs team mode) but no UI or logic exists to switch modes. The coach_mode field exists in auth store but is unused, blocking 30% of JUCO coach features.

context.original_priority: P0 - BLOCKS 30% OF JUCO COACH FEATURES
context.suggested_fix: Add mode toggle component in Header.tsx, implement routing logic in middleware.ts based on mode

issues.title: Multi-Team Support for Showcase Coaches
issues.description: Showcase organizations like Perfect Game have 10-50 teams. Database schema exists but UI is incomplete: no team selector, no organization-level dashboard, no cross-team roster view, no org-level analytics.

context.original_priority: P0 - BLOCKS 35% OF SHOWCASE COACH FEATURES
context.suggested_fix: Create TeamSelector.tsx, OrgDashboard.tsx, and organization page with aggregated stats

issues.title: Complete High School Coach Dashboard

issues.title: CRITICAL: RLS disabled on conversation_participants table
issues.description: Security vulnerability: conversation_participants table has RLS disabled (migration 078), allowing unauthorized access to conversation membership

context.suggested_fix: Re-enable RLS on conversation_participants with proper policies

issues.title: Missing Policies on 15 Golf Tables
issues.description: 15 golf tables have RLS ENABLED but NO POLICIES defined. Depending on Supabase defaults, tables are either completely inaccessible (blocks features) or completely open (data exposure).

context.affected_tables: golf_qualifiers, golf_qualifier_entries, golf_announcements, golf_coach_notes (PRIVATE!), golf_documents, etc.
context.suggested_fix: Add complete policy sets for all 15 tables with proper team scoping

issues.title: Missing: 2FA/MFA setup
issues.description: No two-factor authentication option in settings despite security importance for coach accounts

context.suggested_fix: Implement Supabase MFA with TOTP authenticator apps

issues.title: Add Database Indexes for Discovery Page
issues.description: Player discovery with filters (position, grad year, state, velocity) is slow (2-3s) due to missing indexes. Would be 80% faster with proper indexing.

context.suggested_fix: Add indexes on recruiting_activated, primary_position, grad_year, state, throwing_velocity, exit_velocity

issues.title: Conversation Participants RLS History Unstable
issues.description: Migration 078 DISABLED RLS on conversation_participants with comment 'Nuclear Option: Drop ALL Policies'. While migration 20260108000001 re-enabled it, history shows system couldn't maintain stable RLS without recursion issues.

context.monitor_for: Postgres errors containing 'infinite recursion', message send failures
context.suggested_fix: Monitor for recursion errors, consider simplifying policy logic further

issues.title: Permissive Policies Using USING (true)
issues.description: Multiple tables use USING (true) or WITH CHECK (true) making data completely public to authenticated users. Exposes coach contact info, invite codes, allows notification spam, exposes AI patterns and ML models.

context.suggested_fix: Replace all USING (true) with proper scoping based on team/role

issues.title: Coaches Can View All Players (Baseball)
issues.description: Policy 'Coaches can view all players' allows ANY user with role='coach' to see ALL player profiles regardless of recruiting_activated status or commitment. NCAA violation risk for viewing committed players.

context.vulnerability_type: Privacy violation, NCAA recruiting rules violation
context.attack_scenario: Coach from School A views players committed to School B, gets contact info
context.suggested_fix: Drop 'Coaches can view all players' policy, keep only recruiting-scoped policy

issues.title: Console.log Statements in Production
issues.description: next.config.mjs has removeConsole commented out with note 'temporarily for debugging PDF upload'. This leaves 28+ console.log statements in production bundle.

context.impact: Cluttered console, increased bundle size, potential info disclosure
context.suggested_fix: Enable removeConsole for production, keep only error/warn

issues.title: profile_views Insert Permissive
issues.description: Policy allows viewer_id to be NULL OR not match auth.uid(), enabling fake view inflation and analytics poisoning.

context.attack_scenario: INSERT 10k fake views with NULL viewer_id or mismatched viewer_id
context.suggested_fix: Enforce viewer_id = auth.uid() in WITH CHECK clause

issues.title: Add Audit Logging to SECURITY DEFINER Functions
issues.description: 18 SECURITY DEFINER functions bypass RLS but have no logging. No visibility into function usage, making debugging and security auditing difficult.

context.suggested_fix: Create function_audit_log table, add logging to can_users_message(), create_conversation_with_participants(), are_users_on_same_roster(), handle_new_user()
